page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, establishing a one-to-one mapping with one thread per core. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is provisioned at a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation provides predictable compute resources without the performance variability associated with multi-threaded environments, making it a stable option for workloads requiring consistent execution times.

The balanced resource ratio of the ecs.g7se.16xlarge makes it suitable for multi-threaded applications, enterprise application servers, web serving, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU execution and a standard memory-to-core ratio.
